phrase: yield the right-of-way to all vehicles upon the roadway
note: Inventory all roadway vehicles over the full crossing interval; braking alone cannot decide a right-of-way judgment.

observables.name: vehicle_pedestrian_interaction
observables.description: Ordered approach, overlap, delay and passage for each vehicle.

context_inputs.name: roadway_vehicle_inventory
context_inputs.description: All roadway vehicles with classes, paths and frame-joined identity.

context_inputs.name: priority_context
context_inputs.description: Signs, controls and applicable context for independent judgment.

limitations: Vehicle hard braking is diagnostic context, not proof of pedestrian failure to yield.
A requested yield setting is not a measured result.
